subject.title: fix(pairing): preserve authorized senders when allowFrom reads fail

question: Should this PR be narrowed back to the pairing allowFrom fix, or should maintainers intentionally review the current 300-file head commit as part of this branch?
rationale: The central bugfix is valid, but the protected maintainer label and broad latest commit make the branch scope a maintainer ownership choice rather than a cleanup-close decision.

options.title: Narrow to pairing fix
options.body: Drop the unrelated latest commit, resolve the dirty state, and re-review the original pairing fix with its focused proof.

options.title: Review broad branch intentionally
options.body: Keep the 300-file latest commit only if maintainers want workflow, app, localization, extension, dependency, and pairing changes reviewed together.

options.title: Replace with a fresh branch
options.body: Open or push a new narrow replacement branch for the pairing fix if cleaning this branch is riskier than replaying the three intended files.

recommendation.title: Narrow to pairing fix
recommendation.body: Drop the unrelated latest commit, resolve the dirty state, and re-review the original pairing fix with its focused proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This account owns the current branch refinements, assignment, maintainer-labeled PR state, and the latest broad head commit.
